operators.name: gelu_forward
semantics: Computes the elementwise GELU activation exactly as F.gelu(x) in PyTorch with default approximate='none' (exact Erf-based GELU).
Input tensor may have arbitrary strides; implementation must handle non-contiguous tensors by using proper indexing or making contiguous internally.
Output shape, dtype, and device match input x.

operators.name: tanh_forward
semantics: Computes the elementwise hyperbolic tangent exactly as torch.tanh(x).
Input tensor may have arbitrary strides; implementation must handle non-contiguous tensors.
Output shape, dtype, and device match input x.
Apply GELU activation function to input tensor x, producing a tensor of the same shape, dtype (float32), and device ( CUDA).
Apply tanh activation function to the result of step_001, producing a tensor of the same shape, dtype, and device.
Return the final tensor from step_002.
